name: Teacher's Pet
source:
Foreign exchange student Kat needs to pass an upcoming biology test or she will be sent packing! But Mr. Jake, her biology teacher, has a brilliant one-on-one study plan just for little Kat! If only she could pay attention...

[From itch.io]
